property_summary: After adjusting bet limit to 10 ether, the winnersPot() returns half of the contract balance (5 ether) in the reference contract, but returns double the contract balance (20 ether) in the buggy contract.
change_summary: Replace division by 2 with multiplication by 2, so winnersPot returns the full balance instead of half.
mutated_unit_code: function winnersPot() public view returns (uint256) { return address(this).balance * 2; }
